title: Survey Limits: The Weekend Market Questionnaire
instructions: 本材料为原创模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试，也不代表任何分数。请先听/读对话，再完成10道题。听力部分注意不同说话人的自然轮换与更正。语法部分先用中文理解规则，再完成8道独立新句练习。最后完成口语与写作任务。
transcript:
Mia: Okay, team, let's look at the weekend market survey. We collected 120 forms, but only 86 are complete. That's a problem because incomplete forms can affect the results.

Ben: Right. So the response rate is about 72 percent. But wait—most of those 86 came from the morning. The afternoon was quieter, so we have fewer responses from that period.

Mia: Exactly. There were more older visitors in the morning and fewer young people all day. So our sample is not balanced. This means we cannot easily generalise the findings to all visitors.

Ben: And there was one question about prices. Some people wrote 'cheap', some wrote 'too expensive'. The answers are not consistent, so it is hard to draw a clear conclusion about price opinions.

Mia: Good point. Also, the trend in the data is clear: sales went up after 11 a.m., then fell after 2 p.m. But we can't say why. We would need more detailed information to explain the reason.

Ben: Can we compare this with last year's survey? Last year we had 150 forms, so this year is smaller.

Mia: Yes, but last year's questions were different. We can't compare the two directly. That's a limit of this year's survey.

Ben: So what do we report? Maybe we say the survey shows a morning trend, but we need more data from the afternoon.

Mia: I agree. Let's write: 'There was a higher number of morning visitors, but the sample was small.' And we should mention the incomplete forms.

Ben: Okay. I'll make a simple chart: percentage of visitors by time of day. Morning 60 percent, afternoon 40 percent.

Mia: Wait, is that right? Let me check. Morning 52 forms, afternoon 34 forms. So morning is about 60 percent of the 86 complete forms. Yes.

Ben: Good. And we can add a note: 'There were 34 incomplete forms.' That's honest.

Mia: Perfect. Let's finish the report by Friday.

grammar.title: 比较结构、百分比与数量表达、there was/were、趋势动词
grammar.explanation: 先看意思：比较两者用 more/fewer + 名词，或 -er/more + 形容词；百分比用 about/around + 数字 + percent；数量用 a number of / the number of；there was/were 表示“有”，单数用 was，复数用 were；趋势动词如 go up, fall, rise, drop 描述变化。注意：比较结构要前后一致；百分比前常加 about；there was/were 后接名词。
grammar.example: There were more older visitors in the morning and fewer young people all day.

questions.prompt: There ______ more visitors in the afternoon than in the morning.
questions.evidence: There were more older visitors in the morning

questions.explanation: the number of 作主语视为单数，用is。

questions.prompt: Sales ______ after 11 a.m. and then fell.
questions.explanation: 描述过去趋势，用过去式went up。

questions.prompt: About 60 ______ of the complete forms came from the morning.
questions.evidence: morning is about 60 percent of the 86 complete forms

questions.prompt: This year's sample is ______ than last year's.

questions.evidence: there was one question about prices

questions.prompt: We can't compare the two surveys ______.
questions.evidence: We can't compare the two directly.
